title: Factory Complimentary Maintenance Visits — Terms of the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage
content:
# Factory Complimentary Maintenance Visits

**Terms.** Under the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage, Factory Complimentary Maintenance pays the make's included factory-scheduled services, one at each maintenance interval in miles for the make (a single visit where the interval is 0), within the coverage term; each visit is recorded as a complimentary maintenance claim. Services beyond the included visits or outside the factory schedule are customer pay or fall to a prepaid maintenance plan.

**Visits used.** The visits used under a Factory Complimentary Maintenance coverage, over the life of that coverage, are the count of its paid complimentary maintenance entries less any of them debited.

## Input, judgement and result

| Service presented | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| a factory-scheduled service at the next interval, within the term, with included visits not yet all used | within the terms | paid by Factory Complimentary Maintenance and recorded as a complimentary maintenance claim |
| a service beyond the included visits | outside the terms | customer pay, or falls to a prepaid maintenance plan |
| a service outside the factory schedule | outside the terms | customer pay, or falls to a prepaid maintenance plan |

## Hypothetical count

A coverage with a hypothetical 3 included visits shows three paid complimentary maintenance entries, one of which was later debited. The visits used are 3 less 1, or 2, so one of the three included visits has not been used.
